name: Forensic Evidence Acquisition — KAPE, Velociraptor & Memory Tools
description: Acquiring forensic evidence from Windows systems. KAPE (disk triage): gkape.exe GUI or kape.exe CLI; --tsource=source drive, --tdest=output, --target=artifact target (e.g. !SANS_Triage compound target collects all critical artifacts). Velociraptor: Windows.KapeFiles.Targets with _SANS_Triage selector; Windows.Memory.Acquisition writes PhysicalMemory.raw. Memory acquisition tools: WinPmem (winpmem_mini_x64_rc2.exe memdump.raw), DumpIt, FTK Imager (GUI), LiME (Linux kernel module), Belkasoft RAM Capturer, Magnet RAM Capture. VM memory: suspend VM → .vmem file (VMware) or .bin (Hyper-V).
source: CDSA Module 13: Introduction to Digital Forensics
notes:
=== KAPE (Kroll Artifact Parser and Extractor) ===
Two modes:
  gkape.exe    → GUI launcher
  kape.exe     → CLI (for automation and scripting)

CLI syntax:
  kape.exe --tsource <drive> --tdest <output_dir> --target <target_name>

Common targets:
  !SANS_Triage    → compound target collecting ALL critical forensic artifacts:
                    MFT, USN Journal, prefetch, event logs, registry hives,
                    LNK files, browser data, shellbags, amcache, SRUM, etc.

  Individual targets also available:
    $MFT, $J, Prefetch, RegistryHives, EventLogs, etc.

Full triage example:
  kape.exe --tsource D: --tdest C:\investigation --target !SANS_Triage

Output structure:
  C:\investigation\<source_drive>\<artifact_paths>
  e.g. C:\investigation\C%3A\Windows\Prefetch\
       C:\investigation\ntfs\%5C%5C.%5CC%3A\$Extend\$UsnJrnl%3A$J

KAPE processes (modules) can also parse artifacts after collection:
  kape.exe --tsource ... --target ... --msource <dir> --mdest <dir> --module !EZParser

=== VELOCIRAPTOR ===
Endpoint agent for rapid forensic triage and memory acquisition.

Artifact for disk triage (equivalent to KAPE !SANS_Triage):
  Artifact: Windows.KapeFiles.Targets
  Configuration: _SANS_Triage = True
  Output: artifacts collected to server or local path

Artifact for memory acquisition:
  Artifact: Windows.Memory.Acquisition
  Output: PhysicalMemory.raw (full physical memory dump)

Velociraptor can run across multiple endpoints simultaneously.
Useful for: fleet-wide triage, remote acquisition without physical access

=== MEMORY ACQUISITION TOOLS ===

--- WinPmem (recommended for Windows) ---
Lightweight, open-source, no installation required:
  winpmem_mini_x64_rc2.exe memdump.raw
  → Writes full physical memory to memdump.raw in current directory
  → Requires Administrator privileges

Download: https://github.com/Velocidex/WinPmem/releases

--- DumpIt ---
Single executable, creates memory dump in current directory:
  DumpIt.exe
  → Interactive confirmation prompt
  → Output: <COMPUTERNAME>-<YYYY><MM><DD>-<HHMMSS>.dmp

--- FTK Imager (Magnet Forensics) ---
GUI tool, also supports:
  → Memory acquisition (File → Capture Memory)
  → Disk/volume imaging (bitstream copies)
  → Viewing raw images and file systems
  → Exporting individual files from images

--- LiME (Linux Memory Extractor) ---
Linux kernel module for live memory acquisition:
  insmod lime.ko "path=/tmp/memdump.lime format=lime"
  → Requires kernel module compilation matching target kernel
  → Formats: lime (default), padded, raw

--- Belkasoft RAM Capturer ---
Free, supports 32/64-bit, works even when security software active

--- Magnet RAM Capture ---
Free, GUI-based, writes to .raw format

=== VIRTUAL MACHINE MEMORY ===
VMware:
  → Suspend VM → <VM_name>.vmem file in VM directory
  → Or use Velociraptor/WinPmem inside guest

Hyper-V:
  → Checkpoints contain .bin file (memory)

VirtualBox:
  → VBoxManage debugvm <uuid> dumpvmcore --filename=dump.elf

=== WRITE BLOCKERS ===
Hardware write blocker: prevents modification of source media during imaging
Software write blocker: diskpart → select disk → attributes disk set readonly
Always image original media with write blocker — forensic soundness

=== FORENSIC IMAGING WITH FTK IMAGER ===
  File → Add Evidence Item → Physical Drive → select source
  File → Create Disk Image → select format (E01/raw/AFF)
  E01 format: includes metadata, verification hash, compression
  After imaging: verify MD5/SHA1 hash matches FTK report

=== CHAIN OF CUSTODY ===
Document for every piece of evidence:
  - Who collected it
  - When and where collected
  - Storage/transfer log
  - Verification hashes (MD5 + SHA256)
  - Seal/tag physical media

=== VOLATILITY MEMORY FILE FORMATS ===
raw/lime/dd → supported natively
E01 → ewf support (install libewf)
.vmem + .vmss → VMware (need --profile matching)
.mem → Hyper-V
